batches.title: Batch 1: bad publicity, stealth, scoring and economy

cards.title: Chain Reaction
cards.observation: Playable only after successful runs on HQ, R&D and Archives this turn; trashes two installed Corp cards, then the Corp trashes one installed Runner card of its choice.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: No hidden information beyond what the effect reveals; the cards it names are public.
cards.serializationImpact: Per-turn successful-run facts for each central server.

cards.title: Take a Dive
cards.observation: Run event on HQ or R&D: if successful and a subroutine resolved during the run, the Corp takes bad publicity; the event is removed from the game.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: No hidden information beyond what the effect reveals; the cards it names are public.
cards.serializationImpact: The Corp's bad publicity count and the run's subroutine-resolved fact.

cards.title: The Tungsten Tailor
cards.observation: Static -1 strength on every piece of ice; the first break each turn on ice at 0 strength or less gains a credit.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: No hidden information beyond what the effect reveals; the cards it names are public.
cards.serializationImpact: A per-turn fact for the first qualifying break; strength is derived.

cards.title: Corsair
cards.observation: Barrier breaker whose strength-reduction ability can be paid only with credits from stealth cards.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: No hidden information beyond what the effect reveals; the cards it names are public.
cards.serializationImpact: Payment sources recorded per credit spent.

cards.title: Lampades
cards.observation: Loads power counters on install; while accessing a card, spends a counter and the accessed card's printed rez or play cost, from stealth credits only, to trash it.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: Uses the accessed card's printed cost, which the access already reveals.
cards.serializationImpact: Power counters on the program; the access-time payment.

cards.title: Hackerspace
cards.observation: Location resource that hosts unique companion and connection resources installed onto it at a discount; with one of each hosted, +2 maximum hand size.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: No hidden information beyond what the effect reveals; the cards it names are public.
cards.serializationImpact: Resources installed as hosted on another resource.

cards.title: Nurse Hạnh
cards.observation: Draws two cards whenever two or more facedown Archives cards are turned faceup at once.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: Triggers on cards becoming public; reveals nothing more.
cards.serializationImpact: An occurrence carrying the count of cards turned faceup.

cards.title: Stick and Poke
cards.observation: The first ice encountered each turn gains, before its own subroutines, one that does net damage and has the Runner draw, for that encounter.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: No hidden information beyond what the effect reveals; the cards it names are public.
cards.serializationImpact: An encounter-scoped gained subroutine and a per-turn fact.

cards.title: Virtual Intelligence, P.I.: “You Can Call Me Vic”
cards.observation: Runner identity: once per turn, a click and a credit draw a card and remove a tag.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: No hidden information beyond what the effect reveals; the cards it names are public.

cards.title: Kompromat
cards.observation: Run event on a server protected by ice; if successful, the Corp takes bad publicity unless it derezzes a piece of ice protecting that server; removed from the game.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: No hidden information beyond what the effect reveals; the cards it names are public.
cards.serializationImpact: The Corp's choice and its bad publicity count.

cards.title: Sell Out
cards.observation: Event: trash an installed resource as an additional cost, then gain credits and draw.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: No hidden information beyond what the effect reveals; the cards it names are public.
cards.serializationImpact: The trashed resource is part of the paid cost.

cards.title: Tailgate
cards.observation: Run event on HQ whose play cost falls by one for each piece of ice protecting HQ; if successful, accesses two more cards.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: No hidden information beyond what the effect reveals; the cards it names are public.
cards.serializationImpact: A play cost computed when paid.

cards.title: Borrowed Goods
cards.observation: Chip: memory, and a tag on install if the Runner isn't tagged.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: No hidden information beyond what the effect reveals; the cards it names are public.

cards.title: Rotary
cards.observation: Console: on breaching HQ or R&D the Runner may take a tag to access one more card; while the Runner is tagged the Corp may pay a click and two credits to trash it (an ability any player can use, as Detente's).
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: No hidden information beyond what the effect reveals; the cards it names are public.

cards.title: Baker
cards.observation: Once per turn, a click runs Archives; at the approach the Runner may pay a credit from stealth cards to attack HQ or R&D instead (Elevation's change of attacked server).
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: No hidden information beyond what the effect reveals; the cards it names are public.
cards.serializationImpact: A once-per-turn fact; the stealth payment.

cards.title: Underdome Irregulars
cards.observation: When the Runner's action phase ends: if ice was rezzed this turn, draw two or remove a tag; if not, the resource is trashed.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: No hidden information beyond what the effect reveals; the cards it names are public.

cards.title: Hiram “0mission” Svensson: Shadow of the Past
cards.observation: Runner identity: whenever hardware is installed or trashed from anywhere, the Runner looks at the top card of R&D.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: A private look: the Runner sees R&D's top card, the Corp only that a look happened.
cards.serializationImpact: None new; the look is a private reveal.

cards.title: Aircheck
cards.observation: Stealth run event on HQ or R&D carrying four hosted credits; while active the Runner can't spend or lose pool credits; if successful, the Runner may run a remote server.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: No hidden information beyond what the effect reveals; the cards it names are public.
cards.serializationImpact: Hosted credits on an active event and a static pool lock.

cards.title: Beta Build
cards.observation: Run event: searches the stack for a non-virus program and installs it free, then runs; when that run ends the program, if still installed, goes to the top of the stack.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: The searched stack stays private; the installed program is public.
cards.serializationImpact: A delayed trigger on the program it installed (Topan's).

cards.title: Methuselah
cards.observation: Stealth console: when a run begins, the Runner may trash hardware from the grip to place two credits on it, spendable during runs.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: The trashed grip card becomes public in the heap.

cards.title: Touchstone
cards.observation: Stealth hardware: the first event each turn places a credit on it, spendable during runs.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: No hidden information beyond what the effect reveals; the cards it names are public.
cards.serializationImpact: A per-turn event-played fact; run-only hosted credits.

cards.title: Read-Write Share
cards.observation: On install and each turn start, may host a grip card facedown (up to four) to draw; trashing it shuffles the hosted cards into the stack.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: Facedown hosted cards are visible to the Runner only.
cards.serializationImpact: A facedown hosted group on the program.

cards.title: Sipa
cards.observation: The first time each turn the Runner passes the outermost ice of a server after fully breaking it, it may swap that ice with another installed piece of ice.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: No hidden information beyond what the effect reveals; the cards it names are public.
cards.serializationImpact: A per-turn fact and the fully-broken encounter state.

cards.title: Stowaway
cards.observation: Trojan installed on ice: each successful run on that ice's server gains two credits.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: No hidden information beyond what the effect reveals; the cards it names are public.

cards.title: Word on the Street
cards.observation: To score an agenda installed this turn, the Corp must add this resource to its score area as an agenda worth -1 that can't be forfeited; when the Corp scores an agenda installed earlier, it is trashed and the Runner gains credits and draws.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: No hidden information beyond what the effect reveals; the cards it names are public.
cards.serializationImpact: A score cost; a card scored as an agenda; per-agenda installed-this-turn facts.

cards.title: Méliès City Luxury Line
cards.observation: Agenda: the Runner must spend a click as an extra cost to steal it; scoring it gains the Corp a click.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: No hidden information beyond what the effect reveals; the cards it names are public.

cards.title: Synchrocyclotron
cards.observation: Facility asset: the first Double operation each turn costs a click less.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: No hidden information beyond what the effect reveals; the cards it names are public.

cards.title: Ansel 2.0
cards.observation: Bioroid ice: the Runner may lose two clicks to break up to two subroutines; subroutines trash a Runner card, remove a heap card from the game, install a card from HQ or Archives, and end the run.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: No hidden information beyond what the effect reveals; the cards it names are public.

cards.title: Reverb
cards.observation: Barrier whose rez cost falls by one for each other unrezzed piece of ice.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: Counts unrezzed ice, whose identities stay hidden.
cards.serializationImpact: A rez cost computed when paid.

cards.title: Sleipnir
cards.observation: Code gate: may draw; may shuffle a card from HQ or Archives into R&D; end the run.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: The card shuffled from HQ is hidden from the Runner.

cards.title: Vertigo
cards.observation: Code gate: the Runner loses a click; when passed with no clicks left, the Runner can't steal or trash Corp cards for the rest of the run.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: No hidden information beyond what the effect reveals; the cards it names are public.

cards.title: Caveat Emptor
cards.observation: Transaction with two modes: credits and one fewer Runner click next turn, or more credits and one more.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: No hidden information beyond what the effect reveals; the cards it names are public.
cards.serializationImpact: The Runner's next-turn allotment change (a negative amount, to confirm in VP.3).

cards.title: realloc()
cards.observation: Double operation: choose two rezzed ice, gain each one's printed rez cost and derez it.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: No hidden information beyond what the effect reveals; the cards it names are public.

cards.title: Retirement Plan
cards.observation: Double operation: install an agenda, asset or ice from Archives.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: A facedown Archives card chosen by the Corp is installed facedown.

cards.title: Perfect Recall
cards.observation: Upgrade gaining power counters on rez and when an agenda is scored or stolen from its server; a counter reveals an HQ card during a run, and the Runner can't steal or trash copies of it for the run.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: Reveals one HQ card to the Runner.
cards.serializationImpact: Power counters; a run-scoped prohibition by card name.

cards.title: Méliès U: Only the Brightest
cards.observation: Corp identity with three secret sides: the Corp sets the active copy each turn; a successful central run flips it, and the side for that server lets the Corp look at R&D's top card, trash it and take a card from Archives; it gains a credit when the Runner's action phase ends.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: The active copy is private to the Corp until it flips; the look at R&D is private.
cards.serializationImpact: The secret choice, the flipped state and the side's per-turn facts.

cards.title: Lotus Haze
cards.observation: Agenda: three agenda counters on score; a counter moves a rezzed upgrade to another server's root (Elevation's move).
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: No hidden information beyond what the effect reveals; the cards it names are public.

cards.title: Esca
cards.observation: Ambush revealed when accessed in R&D: the Runner loses a credit, and if tagged takes net damage.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: Revealed on access in R&D (Byte!'s rule).

cards.title: ezaM
cards.observation: Code gate with a click ability to swap it with other installed ice; subroutines look at R&D's top card and may bottom it, and give all ice +1 strength for the run.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: The look at R&D is private to the Corp.
cards.serializationImpact: A run-scoped strength modifier on all ice.

cards.title: Knowledge Seeker
cards.observation: Code gate gaining virus counters by subroutine; when an encounter ends with three or more, viruses are purged and it derezzes; another subroutine arranges R&D's top four.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: The arranged cards are seen by the Corp only.
cards.serializationImpact: Virus counters on ice; the arranged order.

cards.title: Lionsmane
cards.observation: AP sentry: net damage; net damage unless the Runner pays; net damage unless the Runner jacks out.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: No hidden information beyond what the effect reveals; the cards it names are public.

cards.title: Vicsek
cards.observation: Trap: damage and tags equal to the Runner's tags; a tag, then the ice trashes itself.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: No hidden information beyond what the effect reveals; the cards it names are public.

cards.title: Cultivate
cards.observation: Operation: look at R&D's top five, trash one, take one to HQ and arrange the rest.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: The looked-at cards are private to the Corp; the trashed card goes to Archives facedown.

cards.title: Unleash
cards.observation: Gray ops: remove a tag as an additional cost, rez a piece of ice free and resolve one of its subroutines.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: No hidden information beyond what the effect reveals; the cards it names are public.

cards.title: The Red Room
cards.observation: Central-only upgrade gaining a power counter the first time each turn an agenda is scored or stolen; a counter ends a run against another server.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: No hidden information beyond what the effect reveals; the cards it names are public.
cards.serializationImpact: Power counters and a per-turn fact.

cards.title: Editorial Division: Ad Nihilum
cards.observation: Corp identity: the first bad publicity each turn may search R&D for a non-agenda black ops, gray ops or liability card to HQ.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: The found card is revealed; R&D stays private.

cards.title: Witch Hunt
cards.observation: Agenda giving the Corp bad publicity when scored or stolen; when the Corp's action phase ends on the turn it scored it, the Runner's tags are reset to three.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: No hidden information beyond what the effect reveals; the cards it names are public.

cards.title: Magistrate Revontulet
cards.observation: Executive asset: stealing an agenda costs the Runner three more credits; each score makes the Runner lose three.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: No hidden information beyond what the effect reveals; the cards it names are public.

cards.title: Nihilo Agent
cards.observation: Asset loading three power counters on rez: at turn start removes a tag and a bad publicity; at discard-phase end gives a tag, takes bad publicity and spends a counter; trashed when empty.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: No hidden information beyond what the effect reveals; the cards it names are public.

cards.title: Grubber
cards.observation: Barrier giving bad publicity when rezzed protecting a central server; two subroutines end the run unless the Runner pays.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: No hidden information beyond what the effect reveals; the cards it names are public.

cards.title: Lethe
cards.observation: Observer sentry tagging the Runner when bypassed or fully broken; subroutines put an Archives card on top or bottom of R&D and return an installed Runner card to the grip.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: A facedown Archives card moved to R&D stays hidden.

cards.title: Paywall
cards.observation: Barrier: the Runner loses a credit on encounter; end the run unless the Runner pays a credit.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: No hidden information beyond what the effect reveals; the cards it names are public.

cards.title: Flood the Market
cards.observation: Double operation placing advancement counters on one card for each remote server with a root card and ice.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: No hidden information beyond what the effect reveals; the cards it names are public.

cards.title: Scapegoat
cards.observation: Gray ops whose mode the Runner chooses: remove two bad publicity, or shuffle a chosen installed Runner card into the stack.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: No hidden information beyond what the effect reveals; the cards it names are public.

cards.title: Hype Machine
cards.observation: Advertisement upgrade costing six less to rez on a turn an agenda was scored or stolen; trash: place an advancement counter on a card in its root.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: No hidden information beyond what the effect reveals; the cards it names are public.

cards.title: Sacrifice Zone Expansion
cards.observation: Public agenda installed faceup: the first advance each turn gains credits; once per turn, a successful run on another server lets the Corp spend an advancement counter for meat damage.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: Installed faceup: public from install (BANGUN's rule).

cards.title: Luana Campos
cards.observation: Executive asset: at turn start may host one of the Corp's bad publicity to gain credits and draw; if it would be uninstalled, the Corp takes the hosted bad publicity back.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: No hidden information beyond what the effect reveals; the cards it names are public.
cards.serializationImpact: Bad publicity hosted on a card.

cards.title: Event Horizon
cards.observation: Destroyer sentry: trash it to end a run against its server; subroutines trash a program unless paid, end the run unless paid.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: No hidden information beyond what the effect reveals; the cards it names are public.

cards.title: Flywheel
cards.observation: Sentry whose two subroutines each gain the Corp a credit and an optional draw.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: No hidden information beyond what the effect reveals; the cards it names are public.

cards.title: Tocsin
cards.observation: Expendable code gate: from HQ, a click, a credit and revealing and trashing it search R&D for a barrier and a sentry; installed, it takes credits and ends the run.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: The found ice are revealed; R&D stays private.
cards.serializationImpact: A paid ability on a card in HQ.

cards.title: Myōshu
cards.observation: Operation playable after scoring an agenda not installed this turn; it goes to the Corp's score area as an agenda worth two.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: No hidden information beyond what the effect reveals; the cards it names are public.
cards.serializationImpact: A card scored as an agenda; scored-and-installed-this-turn facts.

cards.title: Reanimation Protocol
cards.observation: Liability operation: install and rez ice from Archives paying ten less; bad publicity if the ice isn't a liability.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: A facedown Archives card chosen by the Corp becomes public when rezzed.

cards.title: Vulture Fund
cards.observation: Transaction: gain fourteen credits and take bad publicity.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: No hidden information beyond what the effect reveals; the cards it names are public.

cards.title: Flagship
cards.observation: HQ or R&D upgrade: runs on its server can't be declared successful; persistent: the Runner can't access more than one card besides it.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: No hidden information beyond what the effect reveals; the cards it names are public.
cards.serializationImpact: Run-scoped success and access state, kept after it is trashed.

cards.title: Shackleton Grid
cards.observation: Region upgrade: once per turn, when the Runner spends credits from outside the pool (hosted credits or the bad publicity fund) during a run on its server, the Corp may do four meat damage.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: No hidden information beyond what the effect reveals; the cards it names are public.

cards.title: Let Them Dream
cards.observation: Agenda: on score, searches HQ, R&D or Archives for an agenda to HQ or R&D's bottom; worth one point less in the Runner's score area.
cards.hiddenInformationImpact: The found agenda is revealed; the searched zones stay private.
